integrity: No quotes; paraphrased. No likeness generation for real athletes.

stories.name: Hunter Renfrow

timeline.fact: HS quarterback at Socastee, ~150 lb; recruited by Appalachian State (scholarship) while Clemson offered only preferred walk-on status
Changed position to receiver, gained ~30 lb, roughly raised lift from ~180 to 280+ lb
Awarded scholarship before the 2016 season
Caught game-winning TD with 1 second left vs Alabama in national title game

turning: Chose PWO at dream school over a scholarship
replicate: Ask every PWO offer what the path to scholarship looks like
Weigh guaranteed money vs. fit honestly as a family

stories.name: Sara Groenewegen
stories.hs: White Rock, British Columbia (Canada); club: Washington Sidewinders
stories.path: under-recruited club player found at tournaments

timeline.fact: Said she was not highly recruited; only a couple of schools showed serious interest
Minnesota coach Jessica Allister first saw her at club tournaments in Seattle and Portland
Assistant Piper Ritter persistently emailed; she visited and committed after feeling at home

turning: Club tournament exposure in a non-hotbed region
Agreed to visit a school she had never heard of
replicate: Pick club events where target coaches actually attend
Say yes to visits outside your geography

stories.name: Karsta Lowe

timeline.fact: Two-sport athlete (tennis and volleyball) until sophomore year, so specialized late
Only a handful of East Coast programs offered scholarships; she did not feel comfortable that far from home
Committed to walk on at UCLA with no scholarship money available
Emerged as one of UCLA top performers as a junior

replicate: Late-specializing athletes still have windows
Treat walk-on as a real option at the right fit

stories.name: Olivia Pichardo
stories.hs: Queens, NY (club: NY Crush, Next Level Baseball)

timeline.fact: Played club/travel baseball on Long Island and made the US Women's National Baseball Team
Had several college offers but chose Brown with no guarantee; went through walk-on tryouts
Named to Brown varsity roster, first woman on a D1 baseball roster

replicate: Ask admissions-first schools about fall walk-on tryouts

stories.name: Derrick White
stories.hs: Legend HS, Parker, CO (first graduating class)

timeline.fact: 6-0 senior with no D1 offers; father sent highlight video to ~25 JUCO and D2 schools
Only full offer was Gillette (WY) JC; UCCS coach Jeff Culver offered a ~$3,000 housing stipend/preferred walk-on
Culver: White was first recruit he brought for a campus visit; redshirt plan scrapped
D2 All-American; transferred to Colorado, sat 2015-16, led CU in scoring 2016-17

turning: Following a coach who believed in him
replicate: Email video broadly to JUCO/D2, not just D1
Track coaches who move jobs

stories.name: Samantha Pirosko
stories.sourcing: thin on recruiting details (outcome well sourced)

timeline.fact: Recruited to Gannon by then-coach Jim Brunelli; credits HS coach Paul Force
WBCA D2 National Player of the Year; 35-3, Elite Eight
NCAA Woman of the Year finalist; PA health-sciences major

turning: Stayed close to home at D2
replicate: Use HS coach as the first contact to nearby D2s
Pair athletics with a professional major

stories.name: Ali Marpet
stories.sourcing: moderate (HS name from general knowledge, verify)

timeline.fact: Undersized (~235 lb), played football and basketball; no D1 offers
Hobart pitched economics/Wall Street path; later grew and football became priority
Drafted round 2 by Tampa Bay, highest-drafted D3 player ever

replicate: Treat D3 as a development path, not a consolation

stories.name: Annie Rodenfels

timeline.fact: Started running at 17; soccer conflicted with XC so she ran track only; original plan was soccer scholarship
Came to Centre with little running experience; coach Lisa Owens saw potential
NCAA D3 steeplechase champion

turning: Switched sports late on coach advice
replicate: Multi-sport kids: test a second sport junior year
Target D3 coaches who develop raw athletes

stories.name: Tori Perez

timeline.fact: Became a goalie when a friend needed one; soccer background
Set goal of playing in college during first season
Committed to Oglethorpe for city location and team diversity
Graduated biology; Colombian national team

replicate: Write the goal down early
Score schools on culture, not just level

stories.name: Cedric Coward
stories.sourcing: thin (single blog source; verify college names)

timeline.fact: Switched from football to basketball focus; grew to 6-4 by senior year; not highly recruited
Averaged 19.5 pts / 12 reb at D3
First-round NBA draft prospect after D1 transfer

replicate: D3 film can open D1 doors via portal

stories.name: Cristelle Rodriguez
stories.path: quit in HS, recruited into new program

timeline.fact: Stepped away from wrestling due to pressure and mental health
Joined Doane first women's wrestling recruiting class under Dana Vote
First NAIA champion in school history (123)
U20 World Champion 55kg

replicate: Look at brand-new programs
A gap year from the sport is not the end

stories.name: Jimmy Butler

timeline.fact: Averaged ~19 pts as senior but not heavily recruited
NJCAA honorable mention All-American at Tyler JC (18.1 ppg)
Signed NLI with Marquette as Buzz Williams first signee

replicate: JUCO as a one-year showcase
Watch for programs with sudden roster holes

stories.name: Composite: "Maya" (swimmer)
stories.label: Composite story built from 3 sourced recruiting paths
basis: Swimmer recruiting relies on club coach advocacy and posted times (https://www.wabash.edu/news/story/2362)
Walk-on to scholarship pattern (Alika Crawford, UNT track: https://www.athletes.org/news/my-story-alika-crawford)
Parent-sent video to many lower-division programs (Derrick White: https://www.nba.com/spurs/derrick-white-dare-be-great)

Ask club coach to call
